about: The public (Plugin Hub) build is generated from this source. Code that belongs to a feature the public build leaves out is marked with comments: '// public:cut f' ... '// public:end f' around a block, a trailing '// public:cut f' on one line, '// public:else text' for the line that replaces a cut one, and '// public:file f' on line 1 of a file that goes whole (<!-- --> in Markdown, # in .properties files and .tsv tables). A marker naming several features applies when any of them is left out. Markers are comments, so the full build is unchanged. requires: leaving out the key means leaving out those features too. resources: files that go with a feature.
build: tools/make_public.py builds the public tree from this one: cut lists the features it leaves out, exclude the paths it never copies, export_rewrites the rewrites of tools/make_public.py it applies to the copy, by name and in order (each one's description says what it changes), resources a cut feature's files to drop, to move (to the tests) and its fonts to take out of fonts.json, rules the rule fields, groups, ids and tallies of a cut feature to prune beyond the condition types its code no longer has, and the top-level keys of the rule file to drop (a dialog tree no remaining rule asks for goes by itself, with the rules that answer it), expect the settings (by section), commands and follower menu entries the public build must have exactly, and budget the most the Hub replica (hub_count.py) may count.

features.chronicle: the Chronicle book, sketches, portraits and page news
features.posing: Advanced posing and its Scene tab
features.dev: developer commands, traces and their settings
features.devfonts: the fonts.json override and the fallback fonts only it keeps alive
features.agility-all: agility copying and marks of grace
features.chathead: the animated chathead in the dialog box
features.company-extras: gaze, noticing, will and gestures together
features.gaze: turning its head to the cursor and camera, and the look round
features.likes: place likes and dislikes: the rolled and earned favourite and disliked places
features.messages-readonly: editing in the Messages window (the window stays, read-only)
features.moments: body language: claps, bows, celebrations, the logout wave, drop reactions
features.nicknames: earned nicknames: the offer, the Talk-to question and the name in its lines
features.noticing: walking over to things it notices
features.posing-preview: the anim, gfx and pose preview commands
features.spectate: the spectator: standing clear in fights, fight lines, the shield
features.spectate-keep-fight-lines: the spectator, keeping the fight start and end lines
features.will: the Wilderness-ditch and strong-monster stops, stepping aside
